name: Stevenage Beginners September B 2024
information: This competition is targeted at first-time competitors and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Medals will be awarded to the fastest new competitors. **PLEASE NOTE**: This is a Series Competition with Stevenage Beginners September A 2024. You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StevenageBeginnersSepB2024#42522-series-competition) tab. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free.
